name: P14 battle rules — DQV Tactics (Bram commands, the family fights wisely), the first hour, bosses that care what level you are

steps.note: 1. The first fight of the game: Lv 1 on the Long Lane, Papa and Bobble. One press of Enter is the whole round — Bram attacks, Bobble fights wisely on his own, Papa leaves the lad his monster.

steps.msg: Bram takes orders; the rest fight by their Tactics
the command window is Bram's, and it has Tactics in it
one press of Enter resolved the whole round
Bobble fought on his own, uncommanded
Papa either steps back for the lad or takes the spare monster

steps.note: 2. The Tactics menu: who is fighting how, and the five DQV Tactics behind each name.

steps.msg: the five DQV Tactics
Follow Orders is switched on per member
…and then he waits for a command too

steps.note: 3. The walk: levels, HP, gold and the herb bag carry from fight to fight — no free refills.

steps.eval: (() => { const out = []; for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) { if (__DQ.state().carried.recruitOffer) __DQ.answer(true); __DQ.fight('long_lane', {carry: true}); out.push(__DQ.autoplay(99, 'mash')); } return {fights: __DQ.state().carried.fights, levels: __DQ.state().carried.levels}; })()

steps.msg: levels and EXP carry from fight to fight

steps.eval: (window.__bag = (() => { __DQ.instant(true); __DQ.fight('cobwell_manor', {level: 5, seed: 3}); __DQ.autoplay(99, 'smart'); const used = {...__DQ.state().carried.bag}; __DQ.fight('cobwell_manor', {carry: true}); const next = {...__DQ.state().snapshot.bag}; __DQ.instant(false); return {used, next}; })())

steps.msg: the bag carries into the next fight: herbs are not refilled every battle

steps.eval: (window.__lv1 = (() => { __DQ.instant(true); __DQ.fight('long_lane', {level: 1, seed: 7}); for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) { __DQ.autoplay(99, 'mash'); if (__DQ.state().carried.recruitOffer) __DQ.answer(false); const c = __DQ.state().carried; if (c.levels.hero === 3 && c.exp.hero >= 40) { __DQ.instant(false); return c; } __DQ.fight('long_lane', {carry: true}); } __DQ.instant(false); return null; })())

steps.msg: walked the Lane to the edge of Lv 4, where Bram learns Mend
the level-up is a panel of gains revealing one at a time, not a wall of text
a newly learnt spell gets its own card

steps.note: 4. A monster asks to join — and the question is the last thing on screen (the level-ups wait behind it).

steps.eval: (() => { for (let s = 1; s < 400; s++) { __DQ.instant(true); __DQ.fight('frittering_sands', {level: 10, enemies: [{id: 'cactuddle', partyLevel: 10, areaLevel: 10}], seed: s}); __DQ.autoplay(99, 'auto'); if (__DQ.state().carried.recruitOffer) { __DQ.instant(false); return s; } } __DQ.instant(false); return -1; })()

steps.msg: the join offer can be answered Yes / No
no level-up text is typing over the question
the new friend rides in the wagon and fights wisely

steps.note: 5. Bosses telegraph: Mumbleroot winds up a Cold Draught (a red chevron over its head), then it lands.

steps.eval: (window.__tel = (() => { for (let seed = 1; seed < 80; seed++) { __DQ.instant(true); __DQ.fight('cobwell_manor', {boss: true, level: 7, seed}); for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) { if (__DQ.state().battle.phase !== 'command') break; __DQ.autoplay(1, 'auto'); if (__DQ.state().battle.enemies.some(e => e.telegraphing)) { __DQ.instant(false); return seed; } } } __DQ.instant(false); return -1; })())

(() => { __DQ.fight('cobwell_manor', {boss: true, level: 7, seed: window.__tel}); for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) { if (__DQ.state().battle.phase !== 'command') break; __DQ.autoplay(1, 'auto'); if (__DQ.state().battle.enemies.some(e => e.telegraphing)) break; } return __DQ.log(6); })()

steps.msg: the boss telegraphs its Big Attack

steps.note: 6. What Tactics are worth: the same child (Attack only, every round) at Hoarfax's door — the family on Fight Wisely, and then everybody switched to Follow Orders and mashed (the way this demo used to work).

steps.msg: a child who only presses Attack wins far more often when its family fights by Tactics

steps.note: 7. Levels still matter: four levels under, at the level children reach the door, and four over.

steps.msg: Iron Governess: four levels under wins far less often than at the level children arrive
Hoarfax: four levels under struggles

steps.note: 8. The finale: a child mashing Attack, and Queen Elowen casting on her own turn because nobody told her to swing a staff.

steps.eval: (window.__el = (() => { const cast = () => __DQ.log(300).some(t => /act@elowen/.test(t) && /casts/.test(t)); for (let seed = 1; seed < 60; seed++) { __DQ.instant(true); __DQ.assist(0); __DQ.fight('quiet_deep', {boss: true, level: 28, seed}); for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) { if (__DQ.state().battle.phase !== 'command') break; __DQ.autoplay(1, 'mash'); if (cast()) break; } if (cast() && __DQ.state().battle.phase === 'command') { __DQ.instant(false); return seed; } } __DQ.instant(false); return -1; })())

steps.msg: a finale where the child only mashes Attack and Queen Elowen casts anyway

steps.eval: (() => { __DQ.assist(0); __DQ.fight('quiet_deep', {boss: true, level: 28, seed: window.__el}); for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) { if (__DQ.state().battle.phase !== 'command') break; __DQ.autoplay(1, 'mash'); if (__DQ.log(300).some(t => /act@elowen/.test(t) && /casts/.test(t))) break; } return __DQ.log(8); })()

steps.msg: Elowen casts on her own: nobody mashed her into swinging a staff

steps.note: 9. Malgrim: Nothing At All, then the moment it gives you — a lullaby.

steps.eval: (window.__mg = (() => { for (let seed = 4; seed < 160; seed++) { __DQ.instant(true); __DQ.assist(0); __DQ.fight('quiet_deep', {boss: 2, level: 28, seed}); for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) { if (__DQ.state().battle.phase !== 'command') break; __DQ.autoplay(1, 'auto'); if (__DQ.log(40).some((t) => t.startsWith('act:listen'))) { if (__DQ.state().battle.phase === 'command') { __DQ.instant(false); return seed; } break; } } } __DQ.instant(false); return -1; })())

steps.msg: a Malgrim fight where Nothing At All is followed by Listen, and the fight goes on

steps.eval: (() => { __DQ.assist(0); __DQ.fight('quiet_deep', {boss: 2, level: 28, seed: window.__mg}); for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) { if (__DQ.state().battle.phase !== 'command') break; __DQ.autoplay(1, 'auto'); if (__DQ.log(40).some((t) => t.startsWith('act:nothing_at_all'))) break; } return __DQ.log(8); })()

(() => { for (let i = 0; i < 4 && !__DQ.log(60).some((t) => t.startsWith('act:listen')); i++) { if (__DQ.state().battle.phase !== 'command') break; __DQ.autoplay(1, 'auto'); } return __DQ.log(8); })()

steps.msg: the moment after Nothing At All is a lullaby

steps.note: 10. Defeat is gentle, and it says one thing a child can act on.

steps.eval: (() => { for (let s = 1; s < 300; s++) { __DQ.instant(true); __DQ.assist(0); __DQ.fight('cobwell_manor', {boss: true, level: 2, seed: s}); __DQ.autoplay(99, 'mash'); if (__DQ.state().battle.phase === 'defeat') { __DQ.instant(false); return s; } } __DQ.instant(false); return -1; })()

steps.msg: defeat is gentle: gold floor 30
the priest says what to do about it
no 'Game Over'

steps.note: 11. Sound and the stage: the battle theme, the SFX, and P16's real monster models.

steps.msg: the fight makes a noise
the meadow stage is built
no runtime errors
